# PYNK Product Visuals

Put your product into **any scene you like** — without writing a single prompt yourself.

## Setup

1. Open this folder in **Claude Code** (as its own project).
2. Type `/product-visuals` to start.

Nothing to install. The skill writes the **prompt**; you paste it into your image generator (built for GPT Image 2) with the attachments it lists, in that order.

## How it works

| Step | You do | You get |
|---|---|---|
| **1 · Your product** | drop a clean product photo | the product read back to you |
| **2 · Your scene** | drop any image whose look you want | the scene read back to you |
| **3 · The mode** | Recreate (exact shot) or Recompose (rebuilt around your product) | locked in |
| **4 · The prompt** | nothing | the paste-ready prompt + attachments |

Only have a messy product photo? Run `/studio-shot` first for a clean one.
